_credit: c_u = tau * log 2 is the MOST the non-worst allele can buy against the worse one, in
NORMALIZED risk units. It is the single human-chosen number in the whole Dual calibration;
everything else is measured on the panel or derived from the objective's own geometry.
Declared in normalized units and never in a raw score scale: s_A != s_B in general, so one
raw-unit credit would mean two different credits for the two alleles and would reintroduce
exactly the scale asymmetry the normalization exists to remove.
